sourceNotes: This pass started from https://www.maine.gov/dafs/ocp/ on 2026-09-08 and stayed on maine.gov/dafs/ocp. That is the Office of Cannabis Policy homepage in the Department of Administrative and Financial Services, and it is the dedicated cannabis program site. A browser-headed fetch of the FAQ, adult-use, and medical-use pages returned 200 with the quote text in the HTML, so fetch is enough and requires_browser is false. The FAQ at /resources/faq answers adult possession, public consumption, home cultivation, medical possession, and medical cultivation. Adult-use retail sales are described on /adult-use, which records that retail sales launched on October 9, 2020. Medical dispensary access is described on /medical-use. Previously stored citations on legislature.maine.gov were replaced because this re-research answered those questions from the requested host. The medical rules-and-statutes index at /medical-use/rules-statutes is a link list and does not contain the older dispensary-dispense or patient-cultivate excerpts.
